title: Text: DET Doug Teter ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Can you tell me when Moore passes his physical?
Thanks...when is it? Just for my info so I can circle back. Al said it won’t be for a few days, he just got married
Still working on it.  Probably early next week.  As far as letting you know if he passes his physical..that is going to have to come from Al or David Chadd.  I cant give you that one
I will give you a heads up when he is done though and if one of those guys tells me I can let you know..I will tell you
